title: Validation of a laboratory spray generation system and its use in a comparative study of hexamethylene diisocyanate (HDI) evaluation methods
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00513A, Paper
Hugues Ahientio, Loïc Wingert, Sébastien Gagné, Livain Breau, Jacques Lesage, Simon Aubin
Development of a spray generation system and a comparison of methods for evaluating airborne isocyanates associated with polyurethane clear coat emissions, with emphasis on the spatial distribution of isocyanates within sampling devices.
